🎓 𝗣𝗵.𝗗. 𝗔𝗗𝗠𝗜𝗦𝗦𝗜𝗢𝗡𝗦 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲–𝟮𝟳 | 𝗡𝗜𝗧 𝗖𝗔𝗟𝗜𝗖𝗨𝗧

𝗘𝗜𝗚𝗛𝗧 (𝟴) 𝗣𝗵.𝗗. 𝗦𝗘𝗔𝗧𝗦 𝗨𝗡𝗗𝗘𝗥 𝗠𝗬 𝗦𝗨𝗣𝗘𝗥𝗩𝗜𝗦𝗜𝗢𝗡

I invite applications from motivated, research-oriented, UGC-NET JRF-qualified candidates interested in pursuing a Ph.D. under my supervision at the NIT Calicut, an Institution of National Importance.

📌 𝗜𝗠𝗣𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗔𝗡𝗧 𝗜𝗡𝗙𝗢𝗥𝗠𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡

✅ Ph.D. Seats: 8, under my supervision.

✅ Last Date to Apply: 27 October 2026, 10:00 AM (IST).

✅ JRF Mandatory: Only candidates who have qualified for the award of a Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) through UGC-NET will be considered for Ph.D. supervision under me. This JRF requirement applies specifically to my supervision opportunities.

✅ Postgraduate Qualification: Candidates with a Masters degree in ANY academic discipline are welcome, subject to institutional eligibility requirements and the relevance of their proposed research.

✅ Especially Encouraged: JRF-qualified candidates with backgrounds in Computer Science, Economics, Psychology, Sociology, Statistics, Geography, and related disciplines.

✅ Research Areas: Education, Artificial Intelligence, Emerging Technologies, Educational Psychology, Sociology of Education, Educational Policy, Inclusive Education, Learning Analytics, and several other interdisciplinary areas listed in the attached poster.

✅ Department to Select: Education (ED).

✅ Admission Route: Scheme I, Full-Time Registration with Government Fellowship (as applicable). Please select the appropriate Scheme I option in the application portal.

📞 𝗖𝗢𝗡𝗡𝗘𝗖𝗧 𝗪𝗜𝗧𝗛 𝗠𝗘 𝗕𝗘𝗙𝗢𝗥𝗘 𝗔𝗣𝗣𝗟𝗬𝗜𝗡𝗚
